title: Architecture Decision
description: Defend a technical decision using constraints and tradeoffs.
scenario: An international architecture review challenges one of your design choices.
initial_question: Explain one architecture decision and the tradeoffs you considered.
transfer_question: How would your decision change if reliability mattered more than delivery speed?
language_policy: Tutor speaks concise English and accepts English learner responses.
correction_policy: Select one primary and at most one distinct secondary correction.
completion_rules: First attempt, retry, transfer, evidence, summary and review.
prompt_context: Require a constraint, decision, rejected alternative and consequence.
